scope: Production scaffold structure, skill/intent surfaces, evidence-status integrity, deterministic validator self-test and publication preparation

prepublication_checks.requirement: root README, MIT LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG and package metadata present
four independently addressable skill entry points
examples surface exact 5x3 without invented outputs
benchmark surface preserves exact designed counts and not-run state
validator/tests/CI are real files with executable commands
later-stage install, behavioural, media and maturity claims remain unmade

evidence_limits: The validator self-test establishes structural/evidence corruption detection only.
Campaign and generated-media quality are not evaluated in Stage 22.
Extension Pack behavioural comparisons are not executed in Stage 22.
Clean local/remote installation and host invocation belong to Stage 25 and remain unexecuted.
Remote branch, completion commit/tree/file read-back and CI status are checked after the completion commit and are not recursively embedded in this prepublication report.
